name: lmedr
description: LMEDR -- Learning to Memorize Entailment and Discourse Relations for Persona-Consistent Dialogues (Chen, Chen, Zhang, Su, Sun; AAAI 2023, arxiv.org/abs/2301.04871). Wraps https://github.com/Chenrj233/LMEDR: a BART encoder-decoder augmented with two learned memory codebooks -- memory1 (entailment-relation prototypes, read via a persona-only encoder pass) and memory2 (discourse-relation prototypes, read via the full dialogue-context encoder pass). Both readouts are softmax-weighted sums over their codebook, summed, and injected into the decoder's first hidden state before generation, letting the decoder condition on persona-entailment and discourse structure without concatenating extra tokens. NOT a prompted-LLM baseline; requires a locally trained checkpoint (checkpoint_path config) -- upstream's own checkpoints are Google-Drive-hosted folders, not fetched here (out of scope, same tier as paa/ltkm/orig/bob). No LICENSE file in the source repo (per-file Apache-2.0 header only) -- used for internal reproduction only, see method.py's module docstring. Vendors a renamed transformers==4.14.1 snapshot (upstream's own modeling_bart.py depends on internal APIs -- _expand_mask/_make_causal_mask/shift_tokens_right -- removed from later transformers) plus upstream's own patched generation_utils.py (threads per_input_ids/per_attention_mask through generate()), matching the bob/xlibs vendoring precedent.
